Icons
Semantic icon names available in the design system. These adapt to the active theme's icon registry.

package: @astryxdesign/cli

available-names              Available Names - Components that accept an icon prop use IconType: either a semantic name
                             string or a direct SVG component. The semantic names below are resolved through the global
                             icon registry.
custom-icons                 Custom Icons - For icons not in the semantic list, pass an SVG component directly. Any
                             ComponentType<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>> works; Icon applies size and color styling
                             automatically.
theme-overrides              Theme Overrides - Themes can replace the default SVGs for any semantic name with the
                             `icons` field in `defineTheme()`. This lets you swap the icon set (e.g. heroicons ->
                             lucide) without touching component code, and keeps lookup scoped to the active theme...
icon-variants                Icon Variants - A theme lists the icon variant names it supports once, with `iconVariants`
                             in `defineTheme()`. The list belongs to the whole theme, never to one icon, and Astryx
                             defines no names of its own. Inside `defineTheme`, an entry function...
component-and-library-icons  Component and Library Icons - A glyph that belongs to one component or library gets a
                             namespaced key (`numberInput:stepperDown`, `richtext:bold`) instead of a new semantic name.
                             It resolves through the same registry and a theme overrides it the same way, but the...
